steps.what: Read the applicable administration policies and the student's existing agreed support instructions
Enforce the applicable policies and rules with students through actual explanation, reminders and appropriate immediate response

tasks.design: Link dated school policies and agreed pupil support references in {DOCS}. Keep actual explanation and rule enforcement with the assistant; {OTHER} means the physical school setting, with no automatic pupil monitoring.
tasks.previous_blocker: Policy and support references can require repeated retrieval.
tasks.enabler_now: Native dated links can remove a small navigation action.
tasks.still_hard: Context, communication and appropriate response to an individual pupil require professional judgement.
tasks.human_edge: The assistant responds proportionately and recognizes when the teacher must handle an issue.

ambition.what: Rule enforcement stays a human interaction.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: dated policy links can shorten retrieval without automating behavior interpretation or discipline.

assumptions: Boundary is routine actual rule explanation and immediate response, including real reference reading. Routine reminders do not imply a new incident log. If an actual incident requires a written record or formal disciplinary decision, map that real write and its authorized action separately; do not add a log nobody reads.

The school policy owner and existing support team supply rule/version and agreed support reference. s1 counts reading, checking and manual fallback; s2 all pupil interaction. Test native links first; remove2 of10 repeated navigation units and retain8 reading units. No model, recording, inferred emotion or automated sanction is proposed.
Shares are unmeasured task estimates. Broken-link maintenance beyond case reading is counted below; no external send or formal disciplinary commit is hidden in s2.
unknowns: Actual incident-record requirements for nonroutine cases
research_questions: Observe routine rule enforcement and distinguish it from actual separately required incident recording.

already_counted.description: Policy reading and all actual rule interaction remain in s1-s2.

incremental.description: Maintain policy/support links and repair changed references beyond normal reading.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=8+90=98. Gross2 less1 upkeep gives1. Conservative case: an amended policy needs9 of10 reference units; the1-unit gain just covers upkeep. Pupil interaction is unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Observe performance and record progress data

steps.what: Observe students' actual performance using the teacher's existing observation criteria
Record the actual relevant observations with student identity, date, task and observed result
Total the recorded observation counts and measured results for the teacher's existing progress view
Check the recorded data and totals against the actual performance observations, resolving errors and gaps
Save the checked student observation data in the existing pupil record

tasks.design: Use the existing pupil-record form {OTHER} for actual observation capture and native fixed totals for the teacher's progress view. Keep observation, factual entry, complete source checks and missing-data resolution with the assistant; no model assesses learning or chooses a pupil's level.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated student/task headings and manual tallying may add work after direct observation.
tasks.enabler_now: Native forms and fixed count formulas can reuse headings and total already captured entries.
tasks.still_hard: What was actually observed, the level of support and the interpretation of progress require people.
tasks.human_edge: The assistant distinguishes a direct observation from an assumption and records uncertainty for the teacher.

ambition.what: Provide the same factual observations for the teacher's progress assessment.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: native observation forms and fixed totals can reduce repeated headings and manual arithmetic without interpreting pupil performance.

assumptions: {OTHER} is the existing pupil observation/records system and physical observation setting. Boundary includes actual observation, required data entry, real current tallying and complete checks. The existing record is read by the teacher for progress assessment; no extra report is created.

The teacher supplies the existing criterion ID, task, observation rule and any fixed tally definition. s1 produces direct observations; s2 counts actual manual capture of pupil ID, date, task/criterion, measured result and support/context. Missing or narrative-only observations remain manual; no free structured performance dataset is assumed.

Test native forms and totals first. s2 removes5 of25 repeated identifier/task-heading units and retains20 for actual factual entry. s3 removes only manual arithmetic/tally work that exists today, not already native runtime. s4 retains full source checks and actual correction; connector/formula failure repair beyond them is additional upkeep below.

s5 is ordinary same-system persistence at the minimum share, fully retained and ungated without saving. There is no model, pupil scoring judgement, emotion inference, camera or external send. Estimates are unmeasured; if current totals are automatic that portion earns zero new benefit.
unknowns: Actual manual totals and current form fields
Existing observation criteria and data permissions
research_questions: Trace observations into actual entries and totals; identify manual arithmetic that really occurs.
Test wrong pupil identity, missing date and narrative-only observations without producing inferred results.

already_counted.description: Direct observation, actual capture, complete checks and ordinary persistence remain in s1, s2, s4 and s5.

incremental.description: Maintain existing form fields/tally rules and repair failed totals beyond retained factual checks.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=50+20+0+14+1=85. Gross15 less2 upkeep gives13. Conservative case: narrative-only observations retain8 of10 tally units and individualized task labels retain23 of25 entry units. Four gross units less2 upkeep gives2; observation and full source checking are unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Read the actual equipment care instructions and current student access requirements
Instruct students directly in the actual equipment's use and care, demonstrating appropriate handling
Monitor actual students using and caring for equipment, intervening directly to prevent injuries or damage
inputs: actual pupil handling and equipment condition

tasks.design: Link current equipment instructions in {DOCS}; retain all demonstration and live monitoring with the assistant using classroom equipment {OTHER}. The small configuration touches reference navigation only.
tasks.previous_blocker: Actual equipment instructions and support references can be stored separately.
tasks.enabler_now: Native links can reduce repeated reference openings.
tasks.still_hard: Individual handling, condition changes and immediate intervention need direct supervision.
tasks.human_edge: The assistant notices unsafe use and adapts explanations to the pupil.

ambition.what: Equipment teaching and injury prevention remain direct human work.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: instruction links can reduce retrieval but cannot replace hands-on equipment teaching and monitoring.

assumptions: Boundary is actual instruction reading, demonstration and monitoring. Routine equipment use does not imply a new report; actual incident or maintenance records require their own real writing step when needed. {OTHER} means physical classroom equipment.

The equipment owner supplies current instructions and the teaching team existing pupil support requirements. s1 counts reading/checking and missing-reference fallback; s2-s3 retain all actual demonstrations, checks and interventions. No sensor, structured pupil feed, model or automatic injury-prevention decision is assumed.

Test native links first. Remove only1 of10 repeated navigation units and retain9 for reading; all90 direct instruction/monitoring units remain. Estimates are unmeasured. Link upkeep beyond normal reading is counted below; no same-system save or runtime gain is claimed.
research_questions: Observe reference reading, demonstration and live monitoring separately.

already_counted.description: Instruction reading and all hands-on teaching and monitoring remain in s1-s3.

incremental.description: Maintain equipment-instruction links and repair references beyond normal reading.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=9+35+55=99. Gross1 less0.5 upkeep gives0.5. Conservative case: a new equipment revision retains9.5 of10 reading units; its0.5 gain just covers upkeep. Live monitoring is unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Read the teacher's actual subject-matter instructions, source materials and pupil access guidance
Present subject matter through actual lectures, discussion, supervised role-playing or reading aloud under teacher guidance

tasks.design: Link actual teacher-directed presentation sources in {DOCS} and {LMS}. The assistant retains source reading and every live explanation, discussion or role-play in the classroom {OTHER}; the change removes repeated file navigation only.
tasks.previous_blocker: Teacher instructions and presentation sources can require separate retrieval.
tasks.enabler_now: Native lesson links can make those actual references easier to locate.
tasks.still_hard: Comprehension, pace, access and pupil participation need live response under teacher guidance.
tasks.human_edge: The assistant makes the subject matter understandable and responds to the pupil's questions.

evidence.claim: Model knowledge: linked lesson sources can reduce retrieval without replacing live teacher-directed presentation.

assumptions: Boundary includes actual source reading and presentation. Teacher material creation and separately required pupil records are separate tasks; no fictional presentation report or automatic transcript is added. {OTHER} means the physical classroom and ordinary teaching aids.

The responsible teacher already supplies source/version, intended objective and guidance; the existing teaching team supplies agreed access requirements. s1 counts reading, checking and manual fallback; s2 retains all presentation and response. No free new material package is assumed.

Try native lesson links first. s1 removes3 of15 repeated retrieval units and retains12 for substantive reading; all85 presentation units remain. Estimates are unmeasured; no model, pupil inference, recording or external send is proposed. Broken-link upkeep beyond case reading is additional below.
research_questions: Observe actual teacher guidance, source reading and live presentation separately.

already_counted.description: Substantive source reading and all live presentation remain in s1-s2.

incremental.description: Maintain lesson-source links and repair changed references beyond normal preparation reading.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=12+85=97. Gross3 less1 upkeep gives2. Conservative case: an unfamiliar reading text needs14 of15 retrieval/reading units; its1-unit gain only covers upkeep. Presentation remains fully retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The assistant retains direct pupil work and actual observations, while native references, existing entry forms and real fixed tallying may reduce repeated work.
skills_to_grow: Record direct observations without inferred pupil labels
Check fixed totals against source entries
Keep teacher direction and access guidance visible
role.ambitious_version: Provide responsive classroom support and accurate factual observations while leaving educational judgement with the responsible teacher.
